exceptions.reachability: deepmerge-ts is reachable only through @prisma/config in the pinned Prisma CLI. The committed Prisma configuration is static and never merges request, provider, or other attacker-controlled object graphs.
exceptions.mitigation: CI uses the immutable lockfile and a bounded runner; runtime requests do not load @prisma/config. Upgrade the locked Prisma 7 line when it accepts deepmerge-ts 8 without a forced or major Prisma change.
